definitions.explanation: The act of working; one's work performance or contributions.
How something operates or functions; its role or effect.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{働|はたら}きには{感謝|かんしゃ}している。
{薬|くすり}の{働|はたら}きで{熱|ねつ}が{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: The fever went down thanks to the medicine's effect.

examples.japanese: {脳|のう}の{働|はたら}きを{良|よ}くする。

notes:
USAGE: {働|はたら}き is the noun form of {働|はたら}く. It has two main uses: (1) work/labor/contribution, and (2) function/operation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{働|はたら}きがいい (works well, functions well)
・{働|はたら}きが{悪|わる}い (functions poorly)
・〜の{働|はたら}き (the function of ~)
・{働|はたら}き{者|もの} (hard worker)
・{働|はたら}き{盛|ざか}り (prime working years)

COMPOUNDS:
・{働|はたら}き{方|かた} (way of working)
・{働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎ (overwork)
・{共|とも}{働|ばたら}き (dual-income household)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{仕事|しごと} - work, job (concrete)
・{労働|ろうどう} - labor (formal)
・{機能|きのう} - function (technical)
